Title: Froxlor: Authenticated customers can read other customers' allowed sender aliases
Description: An authenticated customer can read other customers' allowed sender aliases from Froxlor's sender-delete confirmation page when `mail.enable_allow_sender` is enabled. `customer_email.php` loads `allowed_sender` by global auto-increment `senderid` alone, so a customer can enumerate foreign sender alias IDs and make Froxlor disclose those values in the confirmation dialog for the attacker's own mailbox.
